title: How is Hitler linked to Steve Irwin?
description: Five real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Steve Irwin, through skating star Sonja Henie, Norway's King Olav, Queen Elizabeth II and Hugh Jackman.
hook: How's Hitler linked to Steve Irwin?
fun_fact: Sonja Henie won three Olympic golds in a row, in 1928, 1932 and 1936, then became one of Hollywood's top box-office stars.
research_note: Albert Speer and Knut Hamsun were tried first, but neither has a findable photo with anyone who reaches Steve Irwin's era (Speer's 1975 Donahue interview has no usable still), so the chain leaves Hitler through skating star Sonja Henie, whose 1968 museum opening with King Olav leads to the Queen at the 1984 D-Day anniversary.

links.line: In 1936, Hitler shook hands with Norway's Olympic skating star, Sonja Henie.
In 1968, Henie welcomed Norway's King Olav to open her art museum.

links.line: In 1984, King Olav joined Queen Elizabeth at D-Day's 40th anniversary in Normandy.

links.line: In 2011, the Queen greeted Hugh Jackman at a palace party for Australians.
And in 2006, Jackman clowned around with the Crocodile Hunter, Steve Irwin.
